name: Kōnan (Kōchi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōnan city emblem in purple and orange: a purple stylised letter K with an orange star.
history: Municipal flag of Kōnan, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 November 2006.

features.role: Kōnan city emblem — a purple stylised letter K with an orange star
